name: wildwood_scourge_counts_the_elf_but_not_the_other_hydra
notes: Printed: 'Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Your Scourge has two counters. Felidar Savior enters ('put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two other target creatures you control') targeting your 1/1 Hydra and your 1/1 Elf: both get a counter, but only the Elf is a non-Hydra, so the Scourge gets exactly one more (3), not two.
